# GameGuide-AI

> A game guide you can talk to. Ask about any game and GameGuide researches the answer live, sets it out like a strategy-guide page, and keeps the story you haven't reached behind a click-to-reveal bar.

## Features

- **Live research** — answers draw on game wikis, official patch notes and web search at the moment you ask, with sources listed
- **Spoiler Shield** — tell it where you are (`/progress Elden Ring: beat Margit`) and story answers stop there; `/spoilers off` when you're done
- **Missables** — `/missables` lists what you can still permanently miss (items, questlines, trophies, one-time choices) from where you are, without spoiling anything past it
- **Spoiler-safe sharing** — share any answer as a link; spoilers stay hidden for whoever opens it, and nothing is stored (the answer is carried in the link)
- **Game-aware chat** — the page takes on the game's Steam artwork and a colour sampled from it
- **Screenshot reading** — attach up to three screenshots and ask about what's in them
- **Deals** — `/price <game>` shows the best current PC price and its all-time low, via CheapShark; understands nicknames like `gta 5` or `bg3`, and plain questions like "is bg3 on sale?"
- **Installable** — add it to a phone's home screen as a second screen while playing
- **Stealth** — `/stealth` opens a conversation that is never saved
- **Discord bot** — the same answers in your server, plus Watchtower: `/watch add` posts a game's patch notes and big deals into a channel

## Usage

GameGuide-AI is free to use at [gameguide.online](https://gameguide.online).
No account is needed to ask. Sign in to keep your conversation history.
